errors.evidence: The word 'пълешки' is a typo. The correct category label on the x-axis is 'пъпеши' (melons). This typo is repeated later in the description.

The description incorrectly combines two separate x-axis categories, 'тикви и кратуни' (pumpkins and gourds) and 'краставици и корнишони' (cucumbers and gherkins), into a single non-existent category. This results in an incorrect representation of the chart's categories, listing 10 instead of the actual 11.

errors.evidence: The description provides an incomplete list of crops whose yield increased in 2023. While it correctly mentions melons ('пъпеши') and onions ('лук кромид – зрял'), it omits peppers ('пипер'), carrots ('моркови'), and cucumbers/gherkins ('краставици и корнишони'), which also show an increase in 2023 compared to 2022.
